body:
The `DEFVAL`s are also part of the hash so they're important here.
```suggestion
	ClassDB::bind_compatibility_method(D_METHOD("create_action", "name", "merge_mode", "custom_context", "backward_undo_ops"), &EditorUndoRedoManager::_create_action_bind_compat_106121, 
DEFVAL(UndoRedo::MERGE_DISABLE), DEFVAL((Object *)nullptr), DEFVAL(false));
```

This should fix:
```
Validate extension JSON: Error: Hash changed for 'classes/EditorUndoRedoManager/methods/create_action', from D543BA91 to 09864999. This means that the function has changed and no compatibility function was provided.
```

Then you also need to add this to the `4.4-stable.expected` file:
```
Error: Field 'classes/EditorUndoRedoManager/methods/create_action/arguments': size changed value in new API, from 4 to 5.
```

And we already changed this API in 4.0 -> 4.1 so there's a quirk of the validation system to deal with. I think you might need to add
```
Error: Field 'classes/EditorUndoRedoManager/methods/create_action/arguments': size changed value in new API, from 3 to 5.
```
to the `4.4-stable.expected` file even though it's about 4.1 -> 4.5, but IIRC that should do the trick.
